name: insurance-tabular-review
description: Standalone handoff kit for an insurance tabular review product: template catalog package, implementation spec, and clickable demo.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/review-templates && npm run typecheck --workspace demo
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/review-templates && npm run build --workspace demo
scripts.demo: npm run build --workspace packages/review-templates && npm run dev --workspace demo
